papers.title: QuantaAlpha: An Evolutionary Framework for LLM-Driven Alpha Mining
papers.summary: Treats alpha mining as trajectory-level optimization with LLM mutation/crossover; IC 0.1501, ARR 27.75%, MDD 7.98% on CSI 300; transfers to S&P 500 (137% cumulative excess 4yr).

papers.title: AlphaAgent: LLM-Driven Alpha Mining with Regularized Exploration
papers.summary: Autonomous LLM alpha mining with complexity/novelty/hypothesis-alignment regularization to counteract alpha decay.

papers.title: FinCall-Surprise: A Large Scale Multi-modal Benchmark for Earning Surprise Prediction
papers.summary: 2,688 conference calls (2019-2021) with text+audio+slides; benchmarks 26 LLMs on earnings surprise prediction; multi-modal adds signal beyond text-only.

papers.title: Generating Alpha: A Hybrid AI-Driven Trading System Integrating Technical Analysis, ML and Financial Sentiment
papers.summary: Regime-adaptive FinBERT + LSTM hybrid; handles sentiment during high-volatility shifts.

papers.title: Prior-Biased Inference in Asset Prices: The Conditional Post-Earnings Announcement Drift
papers.summary: PEAD concentrated where surprise contradicts analyst recommendations; Sell-rated + positive surprise earns 9.4% abnormal return p.a.
papers.related_hypothesis: H174 enhancement: integrate analyst consensus vs. EPS surprise direction

papers.title: Leakage-Aware Benchmarking of LLM Forecasting: Real-Time Nowcasts as Decision-Time Input for Macro Factor Ranking
papers.summary: RAG-7B LLM factor ranking on FRED macro variables; median monthly Spearman rank IC +0.154 across 3 non-overlapping 12m windows. Leakage-controlled.
papers.related_hypothesis: H198 improvement (H327 used kNN; this is LLM version)
papers.note: H327 already run with kNN version (NOT CONFIRMED, OOS Sharpe 2.4753). LLM version may differ but similar mechanism — deprioritized until H327 root cause better understood.

papers.title: Market-Dependent Communication in Multi-Agent Alpha Generation
papers.summary: 450 experiments, 5 communication structures, 21 months; competitive beats collaborative for volatile tech, collaborative for stable stocks; finance resists all structures.

papers.title: TradingAgents: Multi-Agents LLM Financial Trading Framework
papers.summary: Full trading firm simulation with Bull/Bear researchers, risk manager, traders; superior Sharpe and MaxDD vs baselines. GitHub trending.
papers.note: Already in wiki (multi-agent-llm-trading.md). No new staging needed.

papers.title: P1GPT: A Multi-Agent LLM Workflow Module for Multi-Modal Financial Information Analysis
papers.summary: 4-layer system: input parsing, planning, domain-specific agents (fundamental/technical/news/sector), integration reasoning.

papers.title: 3S-Trader: A Multi-LLM Framework for Adaptive Stock Scoring, Strategy, and Selection
papers.summary: Training-free: Data Analysis agents → Scoring Agent → Selector Agent for portfolio construction.

papers.title: PortBench: A Correlation-Aware, Full-Pipeline Benchmark for LLM-Driven Portfolio Management
papers.summary: Benchmark across 6 asset classes, 10 years; 6,269 QA items; reveals LLMs fail to reason about cross-asset correlation.

papers.title: LiveTradeBench: Seeking Real-World Alpha with Large Language Models
papers.summary: 50-day live evaluations of 21 LLMs; high Arena scores do NOT predict trading performance.
papers.related_hypothesis: General validation: LLM capability != trading performance

papers.title: LLM-based Personalized Portfolio Recommender
papers.summary: LLM + RL + BERT combination; 73.8% annualized return improvement vs MVO, Sharpe 1.45.

papers.title: A Deep Learning Method for Predicting Mergers and Acquisitions: Temporal Dynamic Industry Networks
papers.summary: LSTM Autoencoder + temporal industry network graphs for pre-announcement M&A prediction.
papers.note: Incorporated into H333 design as Phase 2 enhancement.

papers.title: Predicting Status of Pre and Post M&A Deals Using Machine Learning
papers.summary: kNN imputation + PCA/MCA + LSTM Autoencoders for deal outcome prediction; misclassification cost asymmetric.

papers.title: Improving Merger Arbitrage Returns with Machine Learning
papers.summary: ML proxies for expected return decomposition; better predictive power than realized returns for spread valuation.
papers.related_hypothesis: H333 (staged) merger arb — primary academic foundation
papers.note: Foundation for H333 design, cited in wiki page.

papers.title: Spatio-Temporal Momentum: Jointly Learning Time-Series and Cross-Sectional Strategies
papers.summary: Unified neural architecture for simultaneous TS + CS momentum; FC layer learns joint signals.

papers.title: QuantaAlpha GitHub + Self-Driving Portfolio GitHub
papers.summary: QuantaAlpha/QuantaAlpha evolutionary LLM alpha mining; aeriosai/self-driving-portfolio institutional asset management with ~50 agents.
